newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND TOO GOOD FOR FREE STATE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND TOO GOOD FOR FREE STATE.

text.p: Reigning champions Auckland raced in tries either side of halftime to beat South African provincial side Free State 24-15 in a Super 12 rugby union match on Friday night.
Full-back Adrian Cashmore contributed 14 points with an accurate display of kicking, whereas his Free State counterpart Jannie de Beer landed only five penalties from 10 attempts.
After running in five tries in last week's thrilling 40-40 draw with Northern Transvaal, the New Zealand side battled to crack the tight Free State defence.
Fijian wing Joeli Vidiri opened the scoring with a try in the seventh minute and Cashmore added a 22nd-minute penalty to his conversion to put Auckland 10-6 up at halftime.
The third quarter was a scrappy affair with Cashmore and de Beer exchanging a penalty apiece but Auckland took the initiative in the 62nd minute when scrum-half Ofisa Tonu'u scooted over to score.

Tonu'u wrong-footed the Free State defence with a deft sidestep and brushed aside three tacklers to score. Cashmore missed the conversion but landed a 71st-minute penalty to give his side breathing space at 21-9.

De Beer clawed Free State back with penalties in the 73rd and 78th minutes but Cashmore denied the home side a bonus point for being within seven points when he kicked his fourth and final penalty two minutes into injury time.

Free State - Jorrie Kruger (Jan-Harm van Wyk 41st minute); Christo Potgieter (Andre Fourie 71), Helgard Muller (captain), Brendan Venter, Stephen Brink; Jannie de Beer, Werner Swanepoel; Jaco Coetzee, Johan Erasmus, Andre Venter, Braam Els, Stuart Landan, Dougie Heymans, Naka Drotske, Os du Randt.

Auckland - Adrian Cashmore; Joeli Vidiri, Eroni Clarke, Lee Stensness, Brian Lima; Carlos Spencer, Ofisa Tonu'u; Dylan Mika, Mark Carter, Michael Jones, Richard Fromont, Robin Brooke, Olo Brown, Sean Fitzpatrick, Paul Thomson.
